newsitem.title: FRANCE: French journalists pull plug on tax-hike politicians.
newsitem.headline: French journalists pull plug on tax-hike politicians.

text.p: Local parliamentarians who vote in favour of a tax hike for journalists will be refused access to the screens of France-3 on the Riviera, the state-owned channel's local reporters decided on Thursday.

Some print journalists in other provinces have already joined the protest, dubbed "Operation Invisible Man" and aimed at politicians backing a government proposal to abolish a five-decade-old 30 percent tax rebate for journalists.
Journalists say ending the rebate, which carries a ceiling of 50,000 francs ($10,000), would cost them a month's wages.

"It risks condemning the media and the profession," said a resolution approved by France-3 regional Riviera service and targetting any regional parliamentarian who votes in favour of the reform in the National Assembly later this month.
